task.title: P6-101: Add a back button from card detail to the catalog
task.description:
Migrated from specs/TODO-Phase-6.md (Stage 5 — Missing capability). Original id: P6-101. Size: S. Specs: specs/app-ui.md.

**No back button from card detail to the catalog.** "Back to the catalog" exists only on the `LoadFailed` and `NotFound` paths (`cards.rs:598`, `:612`); the successful `CardDetailBody` has none.
